recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，造血細胞間可見許多核圓或橢圓、染色質開放、帶小核仁且細胞質淡染的單核細胞呈間質性散佈，混合巨核細胞與嗜酸性前驅細胞；單憑 H&E 難與正常造血分辨，需免疫染色證實毛細胞白血病變異型浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved megakaryocytes and scattered eosinophilic precursors
Interstitial population of mononuclear cells with round-to-oval nuclei and moderately open chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli in some mononuclear cells
Moderate pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm without the widely spaced fried-egg pattern of classic HCL
Intervening extravasated red cells; no reticulin assessment possible on H&E
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with preserved megakaryocytes and eosinophilic precursors. Interspersed interstitially among hematopoietic elements is a population of mononuclear cells with round-to-oval nuclei, moderately open chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm. The infiltrate is subtle and lacks the widely spaced fried-egg appearance of classic hairy cell leukemia, so its extent cannot be accurately estimated on H&E alone. Findings are compatible with interstitial involvement by hairy cell leukemia variant; CD20, CD79a/PAX5 and annexin A1 immunostains are recommended to highlight and characterize the infiltrate.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL shows a fried-egg interstitial infiltrate with reticulin fibrosis and is annexin A1, CD25 and BRAF V600E positive.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma in marrow
ddx.vs: SMZL typically shows intrasinusoidal and nodular paratrabecular aggregates of small cells without nucleoli.
A reactive marrow lacks a clonal CD20-positive interstitial population on immunohistochemistry.
Mast cell infiltrates form spindle-cell aggregates with fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
